name: influencer.tag_due
description: The people the server's tag job (packages/connect, creator-tags.ts) reads next, at most limit, each company in turn, and in each company those due a tag first, then those never tagged: each with their company, their first Instagram handle, their category, the start of their notes, their bio and what the model would tag from (source). bioDue: their Instagram bio can be read (a brand of their company has Instagram linked through our own Meta app) and was not read for 30 days. tagDue: the category, the notes or the bio changed since the model last tagged them, and its last try is older than the last edit, the last bio read or six hours. Internal.
sql:
select d.result from (
select jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'orgId', i.org_id, 'handle', ig.handle, 'category', i.category, 'notes', left(i.notes, 4000), 'bio', i.bio, 'source', s.v, 'bioDue', b.due, 'tagDue', t.due) as result, row_number() over (partition by i.org_id order by t.due desc, i.tagged_at nulls first, i.updated_at, i.id) as turn, t.due as tag_due, i.tagged_at, i.id
from brandbase.influencers i
left join lateral (select a.handle from brandbase.influencer_accounts a where a.influencer_id = i.id and a.platform = 'instagram' and a.handle ~ '^[a-z0-9._]{1,30}$' order by a.position limit 1) ig on true
cross join lateral (select brandbase.influencer_tag_source(i.category, i.notes, i.bio) as v) s
cross join lateral (select ig.handle is not null and (i.bio_read_at is null or i.bio_read_at < :now::timestamptz - interval '30 days') and exists (select 1 from brandbase.accounts x join brandbase.brands o on o.id = x.brand_id where o.org_id = i.org_id and x.platform = 'instagram' and x.details ->> 'via' = 'meta') as due) b
cross join lateral (select s.v is distinct from i.tags_source and (i.tagged_at is null or i.tagged_at < i.updated_at or i.tagged_at < i.bio_read_at or i.tagged_at < :now::timestamptz - interval '6 hours') as due) t
where b.due or t.due
) d
order by d.turn, d.tag_due desc, d.tagged_at nulls first, d.id
limit :limit::int
